newsitem.title: USA: NYC comptroller says city added 1,600 jobs in Nov.
newsitem.headline: NYC comptroller says city added 1,600 jobs in Nov.

text.p: The New York City Comptroller said that the city added 1,600 jobs in November, while October's loss of 500 positions was revised to an increase of 900 jobs.

Alan Hevesi, in a report released on Tuesday, said that the only strong grwoth was in services, which added 4,600 jobs, with business services, which added 1,100, and movies and amusement, which created 1,600 positions, the key sectors.
Two areas, social services, and fire insurance and real estate, both added 500 jobs.
But construction cut 1,800 and wholesale and reail lost 1,000. The federal government added 600 jobs, but local governemnt, including city government and agencies, reduced 1,400 jobs.
No explanation for the revision in October's data was immediately available.
